prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
UK Independence Party Manifesto 2010 — Summary (≤500 words)

Core stance and governance
- Leave the European Union to restore sovereignty, cut costs, control borders and lawmaking; hold a fresh referendum. Scrap up to 120,000 EU rules, withdraw from the ECHR, repeal the Human Rights Act, and exit EU arrest and prosecutorial schemes.
- Introduce direct democracy: binding national/local referenda triggered by 5% of voters; recall for MPs; proportional element (AV+) in elections; elected County Police, Health and Education Boards; abolish regional government; English-only sittings and devolution run by Westminster MPs.
- Civic nationalism: oppose multiculturalism, promote a single British civic culture; protect British institutions, brands, measures, Post Office; teach British history; St George’s Day and Commonwealth Day as holidays; ban burqa/niqab in public buildings; deport radical preachers; no Sharia override.

Economy, tax, regulation, banking
- Raise personal allowance to £11,500; introduce a 31% flat tax merging income tax and employee NI; phase out employers’ NI over five years; abolish Inheritance Tax when affordable; end penalties on couples.
- Replace VAT with a Local Sales Tax; give councils at least half their revenue from local taxes and 50% of business rates.
- Cut the state back to roughly 1997 size, scrap quangos and “non-jobs,” protect frontline services; reduce council tax via ending EU-driven costs.
- Restore Bank of England prudential control; raise bank capital ratios to 8%+; split retail/investment banking (Glass–Steagall style); reintroduce a lending “corset.”

Jobs, industry, skills
- Industrial strategy to create ~1 million skilled jobs: defence rearmament, nuclear buildout (to 50% of electricity), flood/coastal defences, major transport investment, prison construction; favour UK suppliers and amend takeover rules for strategic sectors.
- Production Enterprise Centres to help SMEs; scrap EU carbon and temp worker constraints.
- Denationalise universities/FE via student/training vouchers.

Immigration and asylum
- Five-year freeze on permanent settlement; thereafter cap and Australian-style points system (~≤50,000 p.a.); leave EU to regain border control; triple border staff; no amnesty; deport illegal residents; restore Primary Purpose Rule; end state promotion of multiculturalism.

Law and order, defence
- Elected police boards; life means life; three-strikes policy; double prison capacity; defend homeowners; youth boot camps; abolish CPS.
- Increase defence spending by 40% (+1% GDP); expand Army and TA; three new carriers and fleet rebuild; more RAF lift/helo/JSF; retain/renew Trident; NATO focus, exit EU missions; streamline MoD; better forces pay/medical.

Health, education, welfare, pensions
- No NHS frontline cuts; elected Health Boards; abolish SHAs/PCTs; franchise services to not-for-profits/private on fixed budgets; patient health vouchers; restore matrons; free eye tests and dental checks.
- School vouchers; protect/expand grammar and vocational “professional” schools; basic skills focus; teacher training on-the-job; reduce Ofsted; selection including vocational ability; support special and home education; scrap 50% university target; grants via vouchers.
- Simplify welfare into a Basic Cash Benefit; allow work up to the tax threshold without losing benefits; merge/streamline child and nursery support; benefits limited to citizens/residents ≥5 years; workfare for claimants.
- Citizen’s Pension of at least £130/week, non-means-tested; target tax relief to low/mid earners; reinstate dividend tax credit; freeze unfunded public sector pensions; scrap PPF and NEST.

Trade, energy, environment, transport, housing, rural, fishing
- Leave EU for a Swiss-style FTA; regain WTO seat; pursue a Commonwealth Free Trade Area and deals with NAFTA/ASEAN; support global democracy.
- Climate scepticism: repeal Climate Change Act; expand nuclear and cleaner coal; oppose onshore wind; exit EU carbon schemes; commission on climate science; electrify transport; bolster flood defences.
- +£3bn/yr for transport: roads, three high-speed rail lines, reopen lines, shift freight to rail/canals; Britdisc for foreign lorries; oppose heavier EU lorries; Thames Estuary airport over Heathrow expansion.
- Cut housing demand via immigration control; prioritise empty homes; abolish regional planning and the Infrastructure Planning Commission; binding local referenda on major schemes; Green Belt conservators; enable council social housing via bonds.
- Farming: leave CAP gradually; promote British produce, ethical and GM-labelling; ease/repeal restrictive EU rules; strengthen producer co-ops and ombudsman; local referenda to reverse hunting ban.
- Fishing: leave CFP; 200nm Exclusive Economic Zone; end quotas/discards; land all catch; no‑take zones; ban industrial/pair trawling; strengthen protection.
